tools.name: list_renders

tools.name: usage

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_template, render, get_render, list_renders, upgrade, billing_portal, rotate_key, create_account, import_document, get_import · Private data: list_templates, create_template, render, get_render, link_account, unlink_account, rotate_key, create_account, import_document, get_import, save_import · Public sink: update_template, render, upgrade, link_account, create_account, import_document, answer_import · Destructive: validate_data, usage, rotate_key, import_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_template, render, get_render, list_renders, upgrade, billing_portal, rotate_key, create_account, import_document, get_import · Private data: list_templates, create_template, render, get_render, link_account, unlink_account, rotate_key, create_account, import_document, get_import, save_import · Public sink: update_template, render, upgrade, link_account, create_account, import_document, answer_import · Destructive: validate_data, usage, rotate_key, import_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
